status: FROZEN at the merge commit of the PR that adds this file. Holdout NOT run.
registryVersion: none (no M2 fixture registry exists yet; the fixture is defined by the generator tree below)

generator.commitSHA: the PR merge commit (a record cannot contain the SHA of the commit that adds it; the tree IDs above are content addresses of the frozen generator and renderer)

recipe.case: one group, one 6-channel occurrence on one affine epoch; stratum = index mod 8
recipe.tones: channel c: amplitude 0.5 at fraction r_c * (1 - 0.02 u) of the lower Nyquist, r = [0.02, 0.15, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.8], seeded phase
recipe.stopband: only when 0.98 * (Fin/(a Fout)) > 1.01: six tones from the output Nyquist to 0.98 of the input Nyquist (normalised)
recipe.landmarks: 0.9-amplitude impulse at N/8 on every channel (seeded sign) and at N/4 + c*N/12 on channel c only (seeded sign)
recipe.inactive: channel (index mod 6) carries -1 dBFS seeded uniform noise; all others exact zero
recipe.multiSpan: one fixed MixedGroup case per split (segment kink, gap restart, unsupported epoch, 44.1 kHz + 48 kHz occurrences); 12 landmarks, 2 cross-occurrence skew pairs. Not seeded: identical in calibration and holdout (disclosed; it is a regression case, not held out).

truth: WWTimeMap forward (alignedTime) and inverse (sourceFrame) of the case's GroupTimeMap, never the render plan. Tone truth x(k) is the exact inverse at the hull ends, linear between (one affine segment).
measurement: steady frames only (every tap inside the span). Tone: least-squares fit of g*A*sin(theta+psi) -> gain dB, phase error deg, residual dBc. Landmarks: parabolic peak of |y| within +-4 frames of truth, sign of the peak sample. Skew: max - min over channels of the common-impulse positions (and of phase-derived time offsets). Inactive: max |y| in dBFS. NaN or a gate with no measurements fails.

renderer.recipe: m2Candidate: Kaiser-windowed sinc, halfWidth 32 taps per side, passband edge 0.8, stopband edge 1.0, beta 9.6, 2048 table phases, chunk 4096 output frames, maximum decimation 64

gates.limit: +-0.1 dB through 80% of the lower Nyquist
<= -80 dBc (in-band residual of every passband tone and every stopband tone)
<= -80 dBFS next to an isolated -1 dBFS channel
<= 0.001 degrees passband tone phase error vs map truth
gates.derivation: max(10 x worst calibration 2.76e-6 deg, 0.001 floor), 1-2-5 series; the floor absorbs Float32 output quantisation (0.001 deg at 0.4 cycles/frame = 7e-6 output frames)

gates.kind: BLOCKED: not granted, no rubric frozen, never reported as passed

holdoutProtocol: Run once on a clean commit at or after the merge commit, with WW_RENDER_RECORDS_DIR set; report every case and every gate (never a subset). Gates, truth, recipe and renderer are not tuned after this freeze; any change needs a new dated freeze revision before another holdout.
